profile.note: URDF joint limits and visual geometry are represented as Moonphys review data. Mass, center of mass, servo gains, inertia, foot sole geometry, friction, and collision tags remain explicit simulation assumptions until Moonrobo provides inertial/collision metadata.

payload.note: Joint-control evidence replays Noetix joint phases, including URDF leg IK phases, through Moonphys joint-frame motor integration, servo, torque, velocity, position limits, and power/work accounting. Each frame also projects the URDF link graph through Moonphys hinge-joint frame assessment and world hinge constraint replay for generic body/joint constraint evidence. It remains review evidence only because servo gains, joint inertias, and link inertias are assumptions.
